customKeycodes.title: Cancel the special USB sleep request and wake; this does not configure the idle timeout. CUSTOM(17), 0x7E11: STOCK_USB_SLEEP_OFF.

customKeycodes.title: Request special USB sleep; this does not configure the idle timeout. CUSTOM(18), 0x7E12: STOCK_USB_SLEEP_ON.

customKeycodes.name: STOCK_USB_SLEEP_TOGGLE

customKeycodes.name: CUSTOM(27)
customKeycodes.title: Show battery level while held (stock Fn+B, wireless mode); number-row LEDs show charge in 10% steps. CUSTOM(27), 0x7E1B: HS_BATQ.

customKeycodes.name: CUSTOM(28)
customKeycodes.title: Send Ctrl+Z (Undo), subject to the keyboard modifier configuration. CUSTOM(28), 0x7E1C: MOR_1.

customKeycodes.name: CUSTOM(29)
customKeycodes.title: Send Ctrl+X (Cut), subject to the keyboard modifier configuration. CUSTOM(29), 0x7E1D: MOR_2.

customKeycodes.title: Send Ctrl+C (Copy), subject to the keyboard modifier configuration. CUSTOM(30), 0x7E1E: MOR_3.

customKeycodes.name: CUSTOM(31)
customKeycodes.title: Send Ctrl+V (Paste), subject to the keyboard modifier configuration. CUSTOM(31), 0x7E1F: MOR_4.

customKeycodes.name: CUSTOM(32)
customKeycodes.title: Send GUI+Tab (Task View on Windows); the action depends on the host OS. CUSTOM(32), 0x7E20: MOR_5.

customKeycodes.name: CUSTOM(33)
customKeycodes.title: Send GUI+E (File Explorer on Windows); the action depends on the host OS. CUSTOM(33), 0x7E21: MOR_6.
